subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supplier Relationship Management
description: A 60-second lesson on Supplier Relationship Management.

hook.text: Two buyers order the same part. One gets priority during a shortage. The difference? Relationship quality.

buildup.text: SRM is the systematic approach to developing and managing partnerships with key suppliers.

discovery.text: Strong relationships unlock benefits: priority allocation, early innovation access, and better pricing.

twist.text: Not every supplier needs a deep relationship. Managing too many partnerships drains time and resources.

climax.text: Focus SRM on the vital few—typically 10–20% of suppliers who represent 80% of spend.

punchline.text: Treat key suppliers as partners, not just vendors.

quiz.question: What share of suppliers typically represents 80% of spend?
